panels.gesture: Caught off guard and briefly bashful: a restrained embarrassed smile, eyes glancing aside and a faint natural blush; one hooked gloved finger gently tugs the edge of his OWN red scarf away from his collar, other hand low. Keep the scarf design unchanged.

A dignified facepalm of silent disbelief: one gloved palm rests diagonally on his forehead, fingers at the hairline, leaving an eye and the lower face visible; eyes lowered and mouth flat, shoulders subtly dropped.

Genuine quiet regret, inner brows raised and mouth softened downward, gaze lowered; one gloved hand holds and gently fidgets with the opposite wrist cuff low at the chest. No object, no chin-touching.

A sudden clear realization, eyes brightened and brows lifted with a small open aha mouth; one gloved index fingertip touches his own temple, other fingers naturally bent. No lightbulb, text or added symbols.

A believable restrained disgust reaction: nose slightly wrinkled, upper lip subtly raised and eyes narrowed; thumb and index finger gently pinch the bridge/tip of his nose, other hand drawn away with fingers relaxed. Preserve handsome adult face proportions, no grotesque distortion.

A genuinely tired yawn, eyes gently squeezed shut; one gloved hand courteously covers his open mouth while the other arm bends back in a compact stretch behind his head. Keep both complete hands and elbows within the cell.

He has heard something unexpected: lips closed, brows focused and gaze sharply to the side; one gloved hand cupped immediately behind his ear and a slight head tilt toward the sound, the other hand lowered.

Sincerely moved, a fragile warm smile with slightly glistening blue eyes and raised inner brows; one gloved fingertip gently wipes a tiny tear at the outer corner of one eye, other hand relaxed. No exaggerated crying or running streams of tears.

A private solemn moment, eyes closed and face composed with earnest humility; BOTH gloved palms pressed flat together upright just below his mouth, fingers naturally aligned in a quiet prayer. No religious objects or added symbols.
